status: proposal only; no wire additions or variants implemented

counterexamples.fact: Native referee view contains both configured dark slots with definition/name/faction; current SeatView has one character_def and no second slot or metadata fields, so its serialized snapshot cannot convey both slots.

Native referee ChoiceView contains guanxing_arrange prompt and exact native kind; current ChoiceRequest has no prompt member. RespondCard/PickTag have no exact ChoiceKind wire variants and remain Custom.

SeatView.absence: Old server missing field deserializes to [None,None]; hidden or unconfigured slot is null; a populated slot always contains its actual definition and metadata.

GeneralSlotView.name: String
GeneralSlotView.faction: String with canonical current native values wei/shu/wu/qun
GeneralSlotView.revealed: bool from the slot reveal flag

ChoiceRequestPrompt.absent: None for older server or no available prompt; display falls back to existing choice kind and option labels.

ChoiceRequestExactKind.reason: Preserve the exact native semantic kind without adding enum variants that older serde clients would reject. Keep existing kind populated with current mappings and Custom fallback.

visibility.Player: Use existing shared PlayerView: own configured slots visible; foreign Kingdoms slots only when revealed; non-Kingdoms configured generals remain public. Choice options/prompt/exact kind only through authorized own choice.
visibility.Spectator: Use existing shared spectator view: Kingdoms dark slots null; no private choice object even with a valid supplied player ID.
visibility.Referee: Use trusted server membership only: both configured slots and all native choice metadata available; legal_actions empty and submit/replay forbidden. No client role or JSON extras grant Referee.

compatibilityValidationRequired: Serialize old server SeatView without generals and ChoiceRequest without prompt/native_kind, deserialize with new Rust types, and assert default absence plus existing field preservation.

Serialize populated new snapshot/choice JSON, deserialize using fixture copies of old WS5 Rust structs, and verify existing fields; old structs ignore unknown fields because they do not deny_unknown_fields.
Exercise old TypeScript consumer with extra fields and new consumer with absent fields, preserving current character_def and labels fallback.

Round-trip both-slot data for Player/Spectator/trusted Referee before and after actual archive decode/restore and real WS reconnect/restart, checking private slots stay null for unauthorized observers.
Prove optional exact-kind strings do not change command tokens, observer identity, continuation IDs, revision, cancellation or authorization.
Test known-name localization fallback and escaping for native prompt/name strings in the UI; no rendering from raw authority.
versionRecommendation: No technical WS6 requirement for these additive optional JSON fields: old Rust serde structs ignore new fields, new structs default absent fields, and existing enum values stay unchanged. Retain WS5 only after the explicit old/new compatibility tests above and user approval of new fields. If instead adding RespondCard/PickTag to the existing ChoiceKind enum or requiring new fields without defaults, use an explicitly approved WS6 and rejection/upgrade plan because old enum deserializers or missing-field readers may fail. This run makes no version change.
consumersToWireAfterApproval: crates/engine-api/src/view.rs and choice.rs: append optional/default fields and GeneralSlotView; keep character_def and existing ChoiceKind.
apps/game-server/src/native_view.rs: copy metadata only from the shared authorized PlayerView/ChoiceView, never from raw authority as a bypass.
apps/web-client/src/types/engine.ts: add optional generals tuple and prompt/native_kind, with nullable slot values and finite known faction/kind strings plus safe unknown fallback.
crates/engine-native-wasm/src/lib.rs: explicitly emit already-filtered native general slots and exact choice kind/prompt through the local projection after approved envelope review.

apps/web-client/src/worker/nativeBackend.ts: extend NativeView/NativeChoiceJson and nativeObserverToSnapshot/choice adaptation to pass already-authorized values while preserving local 0-based versus wire 1-based player normalization.

apps/web-client/src/components/battle/SeatCard.vue and apps/web-client/src/views/BattleView.vue choice controls: consume optional secondary general metadata and prompt/kind with the old character_def/labels fallback; no raw-authority lookup to fill hidden slots.

apps/web-client/scripts/native-server-projection-parity.mjs and native-adapter/choice tests: compare both slots and choice semantics on the same archives, include absent/new-field compatibility, and retain existing ordinary privacy assertions.
remainingScope: This proposal does not close all NC09/NC03 work. Network secondary general metadata, native prompt/exact-kind wire precision and local Worker choice-kind normalization remain incomplete pending explicit protocol work; timeout, wider UI/platform and parent integration acceptance are separate.
